items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Hawk asked me would I consider joining his band

ctx.x: in... He was going with Hawk, and Hawk was going to California, and I heard about it, so he asked me was I interested, and I told him "Damn right." I wanted to get to California, because December here in New York wasn't too cool! I said, "Yeah, I'd love to be out in California." So anyway, he introduced me to Hawk, and Hawk asked me would I consider joining his band -- and he told me what he band. So I said, "Yeah, okay."

And I joined his group, and I... He hipped me to a lot of music, because I didn't know... The things I'd been playing with big band, nobody was using those, not on 52nd Street anyway... They wasn't using those particular tunes and so forth and so on, so I had to get hip to what Monk's tunes were and whatever else they was playing up at Minton's. So that's when I started hanging out up at Minton's, to find out what was happening with the music.
